# Buddy

> An animated companion library for HTML presentations.
> This map helps coding agents find documentation; automatic discovery is not guaranteed.

## Start here

- [README](README.md): dist/buddy.js, one-script integration and active defaults.
- [Agent integration](docs/agent-integration.md): preserve navigation and verify with a light check.
- [Quick-start deck](examples/quick-start.html): no server or build step.
- [Presentation brand](examples/brand.html): a fictional brand configured through JSON.

## References

- [API](docs/api.md): modes, stories, lifecycle and ESM.
- [Slide context](docs/slide-context.md): source data for contextual actions.
- [Reactions](docs/slide-reactions.md): automatic behavior.
- [Contributing](CONTRIBUTING.md): only for changes to the library itself.
